title: Family Group Outside Rural House, 1939 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black-and-white snapshot taken in August 1939 showing six adults (three men and three women) posed outside a white clapboard rural building. The men are attired in dark suits, ties, and fedoras, while the women wear typical mid-to-late 1930s floral print dresses with puffed sleeves and wide collars. The rural backdrop features leafy trees and agricultural fields, reflecting midwestern or southern American rural life toward the end of the Great Depression era.
